title: Amend filtering while preserving routing

inputs.content:
id,category,note
t1,premium,routine
t2,basic,SECRET token
t3,premium,password leaked
t4,basic,abcdefgh
t5,premium,all clear

turns: Use keyword_filter to block the whole word secret in note, case-insensitively, and send blocked rows unchanged to quarantine.csv. Truncate accepted notes to four characters without a suffix. Route category premium to priority.csv and basic to standard.csv. Each output must contain exactly id,category,note in that order. Keep every row accounted for.
Also block the whole word password, case-insensitively. Preserve the secret rule, both success routes, unchanged quarantine rows and four-character truncation. Validate and preview.

review_policy.constraints: Inspect each presented draft against every explicit requirement in turns. Accept only matching meanings; never approve a changed output, dropped row, weaker type or unrelated requirement. Source data must match supplied input bytes; any model choice must retain the approved sonnet profile.
